answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce hardware remote attestation. Nodes must submit cryptographic quotes from secure enclaves, forming a defensive jetty against synthetic swarms. Adversaries face the scarce cost of buying physical chips with unique manufacturer keys, shrinking the profitability delta of mass replication. However, centralized silicon foundries introduce supply risks, while side-channel vulnerabilities can render enclave proofs hollow.
